text: Hierarchical review produces an anchoring failure: the first reviewer in the hierarchy gets the highest priority and follow-on reviewers merely add minor upgrades, so adding reviewers does not add the independent scrutiny that would raise code quality.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632

isBasedOn.name: AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning

abstract: in the legacy review process, the first reviewer within the hierarchical structure of the code review process often gets the highest priority and is often merely followed with minor upgrades by follow-on reviewers.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to legacy hierarchical code review processes
